0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMATERIASLOT_00174_MUTAMIX_000_000
0.description: Pshhh... Shkohhh...<hex:02100103>Uplander is asking Mutamix to shifty-make? Uplander should be hand-swapping five pieces of need-not materia with Mutamix.
0.translation_description: Pshhh... Shkohhh...<hex:02100103>Forestiero chiede a Mutamix di fare muta-materia? Forestiero scambia-a-mano cinque pezzi di non-serve materia con Mutamix.

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMATERIASLOT_00174_MUTAMIX_000_020
1.description: Mixy-melt, melty-mix, squash and squeeze, squeeze and squash...
1.translation_description: Mescola-sciogli, sciogli-mescola, schiaccia e strizza, strizza e schiaccia...

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMATERIASLOT_00174_MUTAMIX_000_030
2.description: Bigeyes! Five need-not are reborn as one!
2.translation_description: Occhi-grandi! Cinque non-serve rinascono in una sola!

4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMATERIASLOT_00174_MUTAMIX_000_040
4.description: Materia reborn glows with much brightshine. For uplander, this is happy-day!
4.translation_description: Materia rinata splende di molto chiarore-brillante! Per forestiero, questo è giorno-felice!

5.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMATERIASLOT_00174_MUTAMIX_000_050
5.description: Shifty-making is exciting chance-game, yes? Even Mutamix has no knowings of what reborn materia will be! Does uplander's heart not be all flutterdance?
5.translation_description: Muta-materia è gioco-azzardo emozionante, sì? Neanche Mutamix ha sapere di quale materia rinascerà! Cuore di forestiero fa balla-balla?

6.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMATERIASLOT_00174_MUTAMIX_000_070
6.description: Shkohhh? Uplanderbag is clutterfull! Mutamix cannot shifty-make if uplander cannot carry materia reborn!
6.translation_description: Shkohhh? Sacca-forestiero è stra-piena! Mutamix non può fare muta-materia se forestiero non può portare materia rinata!
